detailed_chargers.name: Charger
detailed_chargers.finding: Idle wandering, cardinal alignment and immediate straight charge are present.
detailed_chargers.limits: Wander sampling, alignment tolerance, dash speed,1.5second cutoff and recovery are local tuning; the supplied article gives no exact values.

detailed_chargers.name: Drowned Charger
detailed_chargers.finding: Shared charging;10percent extra HP; four diagonal death shots. Flooded replacement and reduced-health Hive births have separate configuration.
detailed_chargers.limits: Projectile timing/speed and authored encounter distribution are not certified by this description. Edition-specific replacement entries must remain distinct.

detailed_chargers.name: Dank Charger
detailed_chargers.finding: Faster dash, wall reflections, slowing nondamaging tar and stationary recovery are present.
detailed_chargers.limits: Trail placement deliberately excludes steep/wet ground. Exact speeds, durations, coverage and reflection limits remain DeathWard adaptations.

detailed_chargers.name: Carrion Princess
detailed_chargers.finding: Diagonal acquisition and spatial tail-only vulnerability are present, including head armor against piercing shots.
detailed_chargers.limits: Authored band1placement does not enforce an Ashpit-only map identity. Weak-point geometry and explosion/fire reach are3Dadaptations.

detailed_chargers.name: Level2Charger
detailed_chargers.finding: Starts on cardinal alignment and steers toward the moving target; dash speed9.5versus11for normal.
detailed_chargers.limits: Exact steering, armor and duration are not established by the supplied article. Band3is an authored analogue; Home ascent is not reproduced.

champion_findings.finding: Special pickup rewards, including Crown battery drops, remain unimplemented; ordinary loot is used.
Eligible champion types are sampled uniformly; the saved wiki distinguishes their rarity. Overall base chance5percent is separately configured.
Green/Brown update paths do not require realized movement. A newly stationary body can deposit a trail. Brown subsequently avoids nearby duplicate dung.

This Fandom copy gives LightWhite1–2orbiters and Brown/Rainbow roughly100times rarer. The pinned wiki.gg reference describes one Repentance orbiter and different rarity guidance. Gray/Small2/3versus.66also differs. Preserve provenance; do not silently replace the installed1.7.9bbaseline.
